definition: a stupid person, used as an insult
hook: Cretin used to just mean Christian.
modernAnchor: We spit it out as one of the harshest insults in English, no religion involved.
journey: Isolated Alpine valleys saw a condition, caused by iodine deficiency, with developmental and physical effects.
Local French dialect called those affected crestin, a form of the word Christian.
The label likely insisted they were still human, still Christian, against the prejudice around their condition.
English borrowed the word in the 1700s, stripped away the compassion, and kept only the insult.
